title: Editorial
summary: Light, calm and confident, like a well-set magazine page: a serif display face over a clean sans body, warm paper backgrounds, generous whitespace and asymmetric text-and-image splits.
radius: 4px on cards and buttons; images square or 4px. Nothing pill-shaped.
section_padding: 120px top and bottom on desktop, 80px on tablet, 56px on phone. When in doubt, add space, not content.
shadow: None on most elements. At most one very soft shadow (0 12px 32px at 8% black) on a single featured card. Separate blocks with a 1px border in the border colour instead.
rhythm: Alternate the paper background and the white surface section by section. Keep one solid accent-coloured band for the closing call to action, and let the hero breathe on the paper background.
hero: Asymmetric split: a large serif headline and two short lines of copy on the left, one tall photograph on the right. A small uppercase eyebrow line above the headline. One primary button, one quiet text link.
cta: A full-width band in the accent colour with a short serif headline, one sentence and a single button in the surface colour. No second button, no form fields beyond the essentials.

title: Glass dark
summary: Dark and modern: a deep navy gradient behind everything, translucent cards with a light border, bright blue accents and crisp sans type. Feels like a product or software page.
radius: 20px on cards, 12px on buttons and images. Keep every corner of one card the same.
section_padding: 100px top and bottom on desktop, 72px on tablet, 48px on phone.
shadow: No drop shadows; depth comes from layers. Cards use a semi-transparent background (rgba of the text colour at about 6%) with a 1px border at about 12% white. Real frosted-glass blur is not available in Divi's settings, so do not promise it.
rhythm: Every section sits on the same deep background; vary the gradient direction or depth from section to section (a lighter navy glow behind the hero, a deeper tone further down). Use a grid of translucent cards for features and proof, and keep the closing call to action on a gradient from the accent colour toward the background.
hero: Centered: a short eyebrow, a bold headline in the text colour, one muted sentence, two buttons (solid accent plus a bordered ghost button), and a product image or card below with a soft glow behind it.
cta: A centered translucent card on a gradient background with one headline, one sentence and one accent-coloured button.
